1. In maybe_seed_entity_event_types/2 (the function you added in the original Step 3), normalize {:error, :invalid_schema_name} specifically to :ok instead of {:error, {:event_type_seed_failed, :invalid_schema_name}} -- every OTHER error reason from EventTypes.seed!/1 must still propagate as {:error, {:event_type_seed_failed, reason}} exactly as before. 2. Update the two stale literal counts in test/letflow/tenant_provisioning_event_seed_test.exs: line ~304 `assert count == 13` and line ~419 `assert count_after_second_call == 13` both need to become 16 -- these fixtures pre-date this run's fix and were never updated for the 3 new ENTITY_RECORD_* event types this fix now correctly seeds for every real tenant. Read the surrounding test context first to confirm 16 is exactly right (13 + 3 new types) rather than applying the number blindly.

After both changes: run mix compile, then re-run the specific previously-failing tests (mix test test/support/tenant_template_test.exs test/letflow/tenant_provisioning_event_seed_test.exs) and confirm they now pass for real -- quote actual output.
